# sRGB2014 ICC profile

- File: `sRGB2014.icc`, unmodified official ICC v2 sRGB profile (February 2015 revision).
- Download: https://registry.color.org/rgb-registry/profiles/sRGB2014.icc
- Description: https://registry.color.org/rgb-registry/srgbprofiles
- License: https://registry.color.org/profile-library/
- Retrieved: 2026-09-28.

Copyright International Color Consortium. The ICC license permits unrestricted copying, distribution, embedding, creation, use and sale. Modified profiles must remove the original identification and copyright information and must not be represented as the original. This repository distributes the original profile unchanged and retains its embedded copyright tag.

Used only as a real ICC-bearing metadata fixture; this does not verify arbitrary color-profile conversion.
